releaseNotes:
# Nightify for Android 0.1.8

- Streamed songs, local files and offline HLS downloads now retain their own playback boundaries through source resolution.
- Long audio containers no longer keep later audio under one song's title or inflate its duration.
- Automatic transitions and Skip advance through separate queue entries with each song's own progress and media-session metadata.

Existing downloads use the corrected player automatically; downloading them again is not required.
